newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Jinlu to pay interim dividend.
newsitem.headline: China's Jinlu to pay interim dividend.

text.p: Sichuan Jinlu Co Ltd said on Thursday that its shareholders had approved the chemical firm's 1996 interim dividend plan.
Jinlu will distribute four bonus shares for every 10 shares held, said a notice in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
The company said the deadline to register for the dividend is October 8 and its class A shares will go ex-dividend the following day. Class A bonus shares will be listed on October 11, it added.

Jinlu said in its interim report for 1996 that, under Chinese accounting standards, it posted after-tax profits of 36.54 million yuan in the January-June period, compared with 24.68 million yuan in the first half of 1995.
Shenzhen-listed Jinlu attributed increase to a drive to cut production costs and increase output of polyvinyl chloride resin.
